title: CAD v15 (RT-14 draft, 1S4P pack)
verdict: v15 = RT-14 routing draft (unchanged board) with the 1S4P pack modelled as a vendor-built brick, real wiring (wires, crimps, housings) and countersunk post-Torx T10 screws: 218 solids, 0 unintended overlaps (96 intended), woofer chamber net 0.524 L, main 1.897 L, print bodies valid without supports (shell overhang 1102 mm2). Brick 86.85 x 74.47 x 21.75 mm incl. wrap (RFQ max 87.0 x 75.0 x 23.0), radial cradle clearance 0.275 mm, rear stop gap 0.63 mm. All wires meet 6 x OD except the J5 leads at the receptacle (R 9.5 = 5.3 x OD: the receptacle faces the right wall with 11 mm free). SW100 still needs a lid plunger; woofer screw engagement stays marginal (M3x20).
